title: The BEST DEAL in the BICYCLE INDUSTRY?? *2026 Specialized Tarmac SL8 COMP*

takeaways.text: The size-50 2026 Comp weighed 7.68 kg with bar tape; it sold for US$4,500.
He notes the Comp uses the same FACT 10r frame sold as the Tarmac SL8 Pro frameset at US$3,500, with comfort features borrowed from the Aethos such as thin seatstays and seatpost.
Clearance is 32 mm, but the bike ships with 26 mm tires on DT Swiss R470 alloy wheels, and a size 54 gets a 40 cm alloy bar on an SL7 stem.

disclosure: GC Performance is a bike shop that sold this bike to a customer; the 2026 US Comp shown has SRAM Rival AXS rather than the candidate's 105 Di2 on the same FACT 10r frame.
summary: A shop walkaround and weigh-in of the 2026 US Specialized Tarmac SL8 Comp before customer upgrades.
